This folder contains the static secp256k1 library and header for Linux builds.

- libsecp256k1.a: Pre-built static library for secp256k1
- secp256k1.h: Header file for secp256k1

How to update:
1. Clone https://github.com/bitcoin-core/secp256k1
2. Build with CMake
3. Copy libsecp256k1.a and secp256k1.h here
